summary: Backend + frontend testing of new RACK-BASED assignment feature. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (auth password rotation, locations, assignments CRUD + dashboard + filters, blind employee my-assignments, mark-done progress transitions, RBAC 403 on cross-role, barang/search rak+zona filters, catch-all). Frontend: login page has NO demo box (PASS), old admin/admin123 rejected (PASS), new admin/Bintang#Admin2026 works and lands on dashboard with 'Tugas Hari Ini' widget (PASS), Assignments page renders 3 tabs + filters + 6 rack cards + create form testids (PASS), Employee /employee/my-racks shows 'Tugas Anda hari ini: A1, A2' with 2 cards after manual nav, expand loads 12 products, blind-count notice shown, no stok_sistem leaked, 'Tandai' marks progress correctly, invalid barcode triggers 'bukan tugas Anda' toast (PASS). ONE frontend bug found: LoginPage.jsx redirects employee to /employee/my-tasks (legacy) instead of /employee/my-racks contrary to the spec — after login budi lands on the old My Tasks page and must navigate manually.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful employee login, user is redirected to /employee/my-tasks (legacy per-item page) instead of /employee/my-racks. Two spots: line 18 (Navigate when already logged in) and line 27 (navigate after submit). App.js catch-all redirects (lines 35 & 44) already use /employee/my-racks correctly, so only LoginPage is inconsistent.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.jsx: replace both occurrences of '/employee/my-tasks' with '/employee/my-racks' (lines 18 and 27).
critical_code_review_comments: Route /employee/my-tasks is still registered in App.js:82 alongside the new /employee/my-racks. If per-item flow is deprecated, remove the old route + MyTasksPage import to avoid dead code and prevent accidental redirects like the LoginPage bug above.
server.py /api/my-assignments/{id}/products correctly omits stok_sistem/stok_minimum (blind count OK). Consider adding an explicit unit test comment marking this as a security-critical invariant.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (11/12 checks; login redirect target is the only failure)

test_credentials: admin/Bintang#Admin2026 (new), budi/user123, dedi/user123, siti/user123 — all working
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded 10 racks + 120 products + 6 assignments. One product in Budi's A1 was marked done via my-racks-done click during test; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_rack_assignments.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_rack_assignments.py -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini has xdist opts). Frontend testids in use: assignments-page, tab-per-rak/karyawan/shift, assign-employee-select, assign-rak-select, assign-submit-btn, rak-card-<kode>, dashboard-today-assignments, my-racks-page, myrack-card-<kode>, myrack-toggle-<kode>, myrack-done-<kode>, myrack-search-<kode>, myrack-item-<kode>. After main agent fixes the LoginPage redirect, retest only the budi login flow — all other flows already pass.
rca of the issue: LoginPage.jsx was not updated to the new my-racks route when the feature migrated from per-item (/employee/my-tasks + MyTasksPage) to rack-based (/employee/my-racks + MyRacksPage). App.js was updated but LoginPage retained hardcoded old path in two navigate/Navigate targets. Fix: sed-style replace '/employee/my-tasks' -> '/employee/my-racks' in /app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.jsx.
